text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Acute! You were amazing in the Japan
Dirt
Derby! ☆

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Your performance was awe-inspiring. I
had no
idea you could run with such
tenacity!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Thank you both so much.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute's performance in the
fiercely
contested race seems to have
left a lasting impact
on the others.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It's just too bad we couldn't be there to
watch in
person, what with summer camp
and all...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
But you held down the fort admirably
while I was
away. Here's a reward for
doing such a good job...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Strawberry ice cream.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Wow! Really?!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
And my lucky color today just so
happens to be
strawberry pink! ☆
Thanks so much!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: And for you, Tarumae...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I-I don't need anything. Just watching
you race
was enough for me. Besides...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
An Umadol is supposed to give to others
without
expecting anything in return.
That's what the
great Falco says, at
least.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Is that right? So you don't need any ice
cream or
gifts...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Then how about this instead?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Braaav-O!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Um... are you complimenting me?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's right. It's your reward for training
so
diligently. Bravo! Braaavooo!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe... That makes me feel pretty
happy,
actually. Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After Wonder Acute gives them both
something
special...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Raaahhh! I'm gonna work hard as an idol
and
make Tomakomai famous!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yaaahhh! And I'll spread the teachings
of feng
shui and bring happiness to
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff! You'll never beat me, Rickey.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Right back at you, Tarumae!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh my. There, there, you two. I love that
fiery
spirit, but do try to play nice now.

text_block_list.name: Tarumae & Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ugh!
Grrr! ☆

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Hm, what should we do here, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, a different training method! ...Yes,
running
only seems to make sparks fly.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae, Rickey, shall we try something

different?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Fine by me, but what should we do?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Do you know any good training
methods,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If we want training that they can only do
here at
summer camp with Wonder
Acute... All I can think
of is...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, shadow boxing! Now, that's in my

wheelhouse.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I've battered my fair share of punching
bags in
the gym back home.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Boxing, huh... Actually, boxing moves
are often
incorporated into dance
exercises.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I wanna give it a try! Please teach us,
Acute!
Pretty please! ☆

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Watch closely now.
Stand like this, and...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Swish! Swish! Hah!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Wh-whoa... It's like you've turned into a
whole
different person!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute is remarkably agile. Each
punch
cuts through the air with immense
power.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: L-like this?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Huh? This isn't right...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Hah! Hup, Hah!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
My center of gravity is so different to
when I'm
dancing. How should I move?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Ohoho. Here, watch again. Like this...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Swish! Swish!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The three of them train together without
any
discord, and the boxing session
provides a great
lower-body workout.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Diving! Why yes, we are at the beach,
after all.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Let's have a free-diving contest, shall
we? I
wonder who can stay under for the
longest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, we head out to the water by the
cliffs.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Pwaaaah... I suppose that's my limit.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Acute?! Don't tell me you were
underwater this
whole time.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
What incredible lung capacity. What
kind of
training did you do to get to that
level?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I may not look it, but I was born with a
sturdy
heart. Even my doctor says so.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
By the way, I scrounged up a bunch of
shellfish
while I was down there. Why
don't we eat them
together?

text_block_list.name: Tarumae & Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Are you, like, a pearl diver or
something?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The summer days fly by in what feels like
an
instant...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bang! Bang! Crackle!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, a peony! And a willow!
Um, what's
that one called again?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: A brocade?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They're all very pretty, but I don't know
the
names of the different types of
fireworks.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Summer camp has been so wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I feel like training with Tarumae and
Rickey has
helped me improve faster
than ever.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
If I can keep up this pace, I'll close the
gap
between me and Falco in no time.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
And if I can reach her level, surely it will
inspire
everyone out there trying to get
a fresh start.
They'll see how steady
effort can always yield
results!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Once I achieve that, I'll be content. I
don't need
aaanything else.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: So, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If Wonder Acute wants to be a pillar of
strength
for others, then it's my job to
be hers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'll do whatever it takes to help bring her
dream
to fruition.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
And I'm not the only one trying to catch
up to
Falco.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
There are plenty of others working their
hearts
out chasing after the same goal,
like Tarumae and
Rickey.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It sure would be nice if the two of them
also catch
up to Falco someday.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I respond in agreement, but there's
something
about what she said that
catches my attention.
Something I can't
ignore.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute is chasing after Smart
Falcon, and
the other two are doing the
same.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But something about this view of the
future
doesn't sit right with me...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If Wonder Acute is going to surpass
Smart Falcon,
shouldn't the runners
following in her footsteps
be looking to
surpass Wonder Acute herself, not
Smart
Falcon?
